# test/layer/walk-checks.txt — the check files that the walk units compile a second time.
# utils/scripts/check-walk-units.py --write writes this file from the tree, and the test
# walk_units fails when the file and the tree disagree.  Do not edit it by hand.
#
# A check file joins when one of its checks can call members_of on the reflection of a
# namespace that a header under include/ opens, because a header can add a member to it.
# test/layer/CMakeLists.txt compiles each listed file after each header that can add to
# such a namespace, in test/layer/walks_across_headers.cpp.
#
# A row:  <layer>/<path>.cpp | the namespaces that the checks can walk
#   unknown stands for a walk whose namespace the analysis cannot name.
